title: Chinese cells where only part is marked (FIXME)
question: You chose "Drop those Chinese senses" with the note "Add in note that a Chinese sense was marked "fixme" and as been dropped." With each sense kept whole (your f-split choice), a sense is the whole Chinese cell; in these two cells only one part is marked. Drop the whole cell, or only the marked part?
body: The other 4 FIXME cells are a single phrase; they are dropped whole, and the English translation of that sense carries the note: "The source's Chinese translation of this sense was marked "FIXME" and has been dropped."

options.label: Drop the whole cell
options.desc: As applied now. The two unmarked parts are not published.

options.label: Drop only the marked part
options.desc: The unmarked parts stay as the Chinese translation; the note says the marked part was dropped.
